responsibility: Wire together and configure the FastAPI application, registering all API routers.
Expose the HTTP endpoint for searching stations by name or code.
Expose the HTTP endpoint returning arrival boards for a station/line pair.
Expose the HTTP endpoint returning disrupted line status summaries.
Expose the HTTP endpoint returning disruptions affecting a station.
Expose the HTTP endpoint listing all tube lines.
Expose the HTTP endpoint returning the live line map view for a line/direction.
Build per-direction arrival boards for a station and line from raw TfL arrivals.
Build per-line disruption status summaries from raw TfL line statuses.
Filter raw TfL stop point disruptions down to those affecting a given station.
Resolve a raw location description (currentLocation text plus a nearby station id) onto a line layout as either a single station or a between-stations position.
Attach the most severe disruption category to each edge of a line layout based on raw line statuses.
non_responsibilities: Does not compute or attach delay figures.
Does not fetch line statuses itself.
Does not derive edge station-pair keys independently (uses LineLayout.edge_pairs()).

public_interface.name: resolve_edges
public_interface.description: Builds one MapEdge per layout edge, attaching the most severe disruption category found for that station pair among the given raw line statuses. Uses LineLayout.edge_pairs() to key disruptions by station pair instead of deriving frozenset keys itself.
postconditions: Returns exactly one MapEdge per edge in layout.edges, in the same order
disruption_category is set to the most severe matching status description, or omitted if none match
Statuses whose severity description is not a known disruption category are ignored
Statuses whose affected route station names cannot be resolved to station ids are ignored

responsibility: Load and provide lookup access to tube stations and lines.
Load the node/edge layout for a line and direction from static map data.
Fetch and parse raw arrivals, line statuses, and stop point disruptions from the TfL API.
Parse a platform name string into a direction and platform number.
Parse a raw currentLocation string into a structured at-station/between-stations description.
Define Station and Line data schemas and station code derivation.
Define arrival board data schemas and arrival time display formatting.
Define line status summary data schemas.
Define the station disruption data schema.
Define line layout node/edge data schemas and provide lookup helpers over a line's node/edge structure.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch or load layout data from disk (delegates to line_layout_repository).
Does not know about disruption categories or delay figures.

public_interface.name: next_station_id
public_interface.description: Finds the id of the station immediately following from_station_id when traversing edges in their stored direction.
postconditions: Returns the to_station_id of the first edge whose from_station_id matches, or None if no such edge exists

public_interface.name: edge_pairs
public_interface.description: Builds a lookup from the order-independent station-pair of each edge to that edge, so callers can key per-edge data (disruptions, delays) without deriving frozenset pairs themselves.
postconditions: Returns one entry per edge in self.edges, keyed by frozenset((edge.from_station_id, edge.to_station_id))
If two edges share the same station pair, the later edge in self.edges wins that key's entry

responsibility: Define the client-side route-to-page mapping.
Bootstrap and mount the React application.
Provide the global stylesheet entry point.
Provide ambient TypeScript environment type declarations for Vite.
Render the station search landing page and the entry point to the live map feature.
Render line selection when a searched station is served by multiple lines.
Render the arrival board and disruptions for a selected station/line.
Render line selection for the live map feature.
Render the live map page, polling for and passing line map view data to the map component.
Render a single direction's arrival board table.
Render a single line's disruption status summary.
Render the list of disruptions for a station.
Render a selectable list of tube lines.
Wrap backend HTTP endpoints as typed fetch functions.
Generic hook for polling an async data source on an interval.
Fetch the raw delay-estimate records for all tube lines from the Upstash Redis REST API and parse them into typed objects.
non_responsibilities: Does not map trackernetCode to lineId.
Does not filter, group, or average delay records by station or edge.
Does not decide how delays are displayed.

public_interface.name: get_delay_estimates
public_interface.description: Fetches and parses the current contents of the delay-estimates redis key into a list of raw delay estimate records covering all lines.
preconditions: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN environment variables are set
postconditions: Returns one RawDelayEstimate per entry currently stored under the delay-estimates key
Raises DelayEstimatesClientError if the request fails or the payload cannot be parsed

responsibility: Provide the static lookup from a tube lineId to the trackernetCode used by the delay-estimates feed.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch or cache any remote data.
Does not validate that a lineId has a live-map layout.

public_interface.name: get_trackernet_code
public_interface.description: Looks up the trackernetCode for a given tube lineId.
preconditions: line_id is one of the known tube line ids (bakerloo, central, circle, district, hammersmith-city, jubilee, metropolitan, northern, piccadilly, victoria, waterloo-city)
postconditions: Returns the matching trackernetCode
circle and hammersmith-city both return "H"

responsibility: Annotate already-built line-map nodes and edges with an average delay in whole minutes per station and per edge, computed from raw delay-estimate records for one line.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch delay data from Redis.
Does not know the lineId-to-trackernetCode mapping (receives the code as a parameter).
Does not decide display formatting, labels, or colors.
Does not parse currentLocation text itself (delegates to train_position_resolver, reusing the same at-station/between-stations resolution used for train markers).
Does not construct the base MapNode/MapEdge objects (receives them already built and only returns them with delay_minutes attached).

public_interface.name: resolve
public_interface.description: Filters records to the given trackernetCode, resolves each onto the layout via train_position_resolver, averages delayed_seconds per station id and per edge station-pair (via layout.edge_pairs()) into whole minutes, and returns copies of the given nodes/edges with delay_minutes set wherever matching data exists.
preconditions: layout, nodes, and edges all correspond to the line identified by trackernet_code
postconditions: Returns the same number of nodes/edges as given, in the same order, with all non-delay fields unchanged
Records whose trackernet_code does not match are ignored
Records train_position_resolver cannot resolve onto the layout are ignored
Average minutes are clamped to a minimum of 0
delay_minutes is left unset on any node/edge with no matching records

responsibility: Define the response data schemas for the live line map view: nodes, edges, train markers, and their optional delay figures.
non_responsibilities: Does not compute delay_minutes or disruption_category values.
Does not perform any station or layout lookups.

responsibility: Orchestrate fetching a line's layout, statuses, arrivals, and delay estimates, and assemble them into one LineMapView with delay figures attached to nodes and edges.
non_responsibilities: Does not parse currentLocation strings itself (delegates to train_position_resolver/delay_estimate_resolver).
Does not compute delay averages itself (delegates to delay_estimate_resolver).
Does not know the lineId-to-trackernetCode mapping table (delegates to trackernet_codes).
Does not merge delay figures into node/edge objects itself (delay_estimate_resolver returns fully-annotated MapNode/MapEdge lists ready to embed).

public_interface.name: get_line_map
public_interface.description: Builds the full live map view for a line and direction, including per-station and per-edge delay minutes derived from the delay-estimates feed.
postconditions: Raises LineNotFoundError if line_id is not a known tube line
Each node/edge includes delay_minutes when matching delay-estimate data exists for that station/edge, otherwise it is omitted

responsibility: Define shared TypeScript interfaces mirroring backend API response shapes used across pages and components.
non_responsibilities: Does not perform any runtime validation or transformation of API responses.

responsibility: Render the SVG live tube map, drawing station nodes, edges, train markers, and delay-minute badges for stations/edges that have data.
non_responsibilities: Does not fetch map or delay data.
Does not compute delay averages.
Does not manage polling or routing.

public_interface.name: TubeMapView
public_interface.description: React component that renders the live tube map SVG given nodes, edges, trains, and the line's color, showing a '+N' delay badge beside any station or edge that has delay data, colored red above 10 minutes.
postconditions: No delay badge is rendered for a station/edge whose delay_minutes is null or undefined
A delay_minutes of 0 renders as "+0"
A delay_minutes greater than 10 renders in red
